units.source_text: 我从未曾接受过别人的礼物，不管怎么样，接受礼物还是值得高兴的。

en.t: I had never received a gift from anyone before, but in any case, receiving a gift was still something to be happy about.
I took it in my hands and looked it over.

units.source_text: 只见尺八前面有四个孔，后面一个孔。

en.t: I saw that the shakuhachi had four holes on the front and one hole on the back.
